description: Presidential Secretariat - Appointments of 09 Ministers including Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva M.P.
categorisation: This gazette contains both the names of specific individuals (e.g., Hon. Nimal Siripala de Silva, M.P.) and detailed descriptions of their ministerial portfolios (e.g., Minister of Ports, Shipping and Aviation; Minister of Justice, Prison Affairs and Constitutional Reforms). This combination of "who" (government personnel) and "what" (detailed portfolio responsibilities) meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
